QUOTE: Mbed TLS packs each error as a module (high-level) part and a specific (low-level) part ... If both parts exist, it writes `" : "` and appends the low-level text.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a code has high-level (module) and low-level parts and that mbedtls_strerror joins both with " : " when both are present.
